name: Screen Capture / Shoulder Surfing Documentation
description: Unlocked or unattended screens visible during physical traversal may display sensitive information — internal dashboards, HR systems, financial data, security monitoring interfaces, or active credentials. Body-worn cameras capture this incidentally during normal movement, while deliberate documentation of specific screens provides targeted evidence of data exposure risk. This technique requires no interaction with the target system and leaves no forensic trace.

blue.det: Camera footage of individual photographing screens; employee reports someone looking over their shoulder; privacy filter absence noted during security walkthrough.
blue.cm: Screen privacy filters on all workstations in open or visible areas; clean screen policy — lock when stepping away; position monitors away from public sight lines; security awareness training on shoulder surfing.
